card.name: Spear Cretin
card.officialText: FLIP: When this card is sent to the Graveyard after being flipped, each player selects 1 monster from their Graveyard, and Special Summons it in face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position.

design.scope: Isolated TagDuel adapter/test/evidence/workflow; no central resolver or catalog registration.
design.trigger: Requires a real prior flip followed by movement from the Monster Zone to the physical owner's team Graveyard. The cause may be battle or a card effect; it is not battle-destruction-only.
design.timing: The trigger is registered without targets or Graveyard choices. At resolution, each team independently selects one monster from its own shared Graveyard.
design.mandatoryChoice: If a team has at least one eligible monster and an open Monster Zone, it must choose one; if it has no eligible monster or its three Monster Zones are full, its choice is null and the other team may still resolve.
design.position: Each team independently chooses face-up Attack Position or face-down Defense Position, exactly as the card text specifies.
design.ownership: The summoned monster is controlled by the team whose Graveyard supplied it, while its physical owner seat is preserved from the UID, including an inactive partner's card.
design.sourceCanReturn: Spear Cretin itself remains an eligible monster in its owner's Graveyard and may be selected by its own team.
design.eligibility: Non-monsters and tokens are excluded. Fusion/Ritual monsters require properlySummoned=true. Other summon restrictions not represented by the current metadata are not inferred.
design.atomicity: Both teams' choices are validated before either card moves; a stale/invalid second choice cannot partially resolve the first.
design.replay: A durable activationId receipt is persisted in JSON and prevents duplicate registration/resolution.
design.capacity: Three shared Monster Zones and three Spell/Trap Zones per team; Field Zone is separate; Extra Deck remains at five.
design.hand: No hand truncation or discard occurs; the End Phase retains responsibility for the six-card limit.
design.deck: Decks are untouched; the 20–30 Main Deck rule remains a deck-construction constraint, not a minimum for an in-progress duel.

certification.reason: Adapter-only preparation. Spear Cretin is absent from cardMetadata, cardCatalog, monsterEffects and cardCertifications on the shared HEAD. No M61 handoff was granted; resolver/catalog/manifest/allowlist were not changed.

limitations: Adapter is not registered in the central monster-effect resolver; Spear Cretin remains unavailable for normal deck admission and uncertified.
The 28 focused tests use offline TagDuel fixtures and injected card metadata; no live Discord gateway or guild was used.
The actual Flip-to-GY event producer and player choice UI remain to be wired after the protected resolver handoff.
Special Summon restrictions beyond available monster kind/type and Fusion/Ritual proper-summon metadata are not inferred by this isolated adapter.
